name: Brenna Coldwater
acBreakdown: Scale mail +4, Dex +1, wooden shield +1, Shield Expert +1

weapons.name: Longsword
weapons.notes: Advantage on your first attack with it each round. Two-handed (no shield): 1d10+4.

personality: Six winters on the Boldock Wall taught you that the dark beyond the firelight is full of things that want in. You took the Keepers' coin to see the world past the Red Waste. You have never shared a fire with an orc and you are not sure you can start now.
hook: There is an orc chieftain in the common room, and the house rules say no fighting.
abilitiesHtml:
Weapon Specialisation (longsword). Advantage on the first attack roll you make with it each round, and +1 damage (already in the line above).

Combat Manoeuvres. You can use every manoeuvre in the Codex (Trip, Disarm, Shove, Shield Blow, Guard and the rest). Your own: Intimidating Strike, on a hit the target makes a Will save (DC 14) or is Frightened until the end of its next turn.

Combat Reflexes (free feat). Once per round, an Attack of Opportunity against an enemy you can see that leaves your reach or moves past or through it. Disengage prevents it.

Toughness (Human bonus feat). +1 HP a level (included) and Advantage on Constitution checks.

Shield Expert (feat, 1st). +1 AC with a shield (included), and your shield bonus adds to Reflex saves (included).

Mighty Deed of Arms (feat, 3rd). Once per round, call your shot and roll a d4 with the attack. On a hit and a 3 or 4: knock Prone, disarm, push 10ft, blind until the end of its next turn, or give it Disadvantage on its next attack. Save DC 14 (Fortitude for prone, push or disarm; Reflex for blind; Will for the penalty). A creature that saves is immune for the fight.

Kit: Boldock Wall Guard. Waste-Hardened: Advantage on your first attack roll each round against creatures with the Orc ancestry tag. Wall Authority: Advantage on Perception checks on watch or guard duty.

Human. Advantage on Tracking checks (chosen skill).

name: Hulda Frostbraid

weapons.name: Light crossbow
weapons.notes: 80ft. Armour Piercing. One shot a round.

spells.notes: Other good picks tonight: Shield of Faith, Protection from Alignment, Detect Secret Doors (1st); Silence, Hold Person, Lesser Restoration (2nd).

personality: Ilmater is the god of those who suffer through the long winter, and you go where the suffering is. The Keepers pay a field priest's wage. You have set bones in blizzards before and you are quietly proud of it.
hook: Someone upstairs is very ill. Nobody will let you see him.
abilitiesHtml:
Spellcasting. Wisdom. Spell save DC 14. Slots: 4 cantrips, three 1st, two 2nd. Prepare 6 spells each morning from the whole Cleric list. See the spell page.

Turn Undead. 6 times a day, as an action: undead within 30ft that can see or hear you make a Will save (DC 14) or flee and stay beyond 30ft for 1 minute.

Ilmater's Favour. Advantage on First Aid/Healing checks. Once a day: heal a creature 2d8+3 HP. Favoured weapon: cestus.

Healer (feat, 1st). Healing spells and brewed potions restore +1 HP per die. Once a day, cast a healing spell of 3rd level or lower without spending a slot.

Dwarf. Speed never reduced by armour or encumbrance. Advantage on stonework checks. Stonebraced: once per long rest, treat a critical hit against you as a normal hit, or ignore a knockdown. Advantage on Brewing checks (chosen craft). Clan weapon: your grandmother's war hammer.

name: Pip Thistlewick
acBreakdown: Leather armour +2, Dex +3. Leather is Insulated: Resistance 5 to cold

weapons.name: Knife
weapons.notes: Throwing knives, 20ft. Finesse, Light, Concealable, Thrown. Knives bundle 5 a slot, so both take 1.

personality: The Keepers think you are a scout. The Veiled Ones think you are their eyes on the frontier. Both are paying you, and you would like to keep it that way. You notice things, write them down, and pass them on.
hook: The innkeeper keeps a locked door behind the bar, and he checks it every hour.
abilitiesHtml:
Sneak Attack. Once a round, against an aware but unsuspecting target within 30ft (it can't see you, hasn't acted yet this fight, or is in melee with an ally and not you): Advantage on the attack and +2d6 damage (1d6 Rogue, +1d6 Predator). Cannot combine with Back Attack.

Back Attack. Once a round, after a successful Hide or Move Silently check, attacking from behind with a melee weapon shorter than your arm: Advantage and the weapon's dice are doubled (short sword 2d6+4).

Rogue Skills. Climb (Dex), Decipher Script (Int), Open Locks (Dex, one try per lock per level; Advantage with your lockpicks), Pick Pocket (Dex, DC 10 + target's Level), Find, Disable or Set Trap (Int). Thieves' Cant.

Hide and Move Silently. Normal roll at half speed or less, Disadvantage above it. You can Hide while only lightly obscured. Both at once: Disadvantage on both, quarter speed.

Cunning Step. Once a round, move away from a creature in your reach without provoking.

Alertness (feat, 1st). You can't be surprised by nonmagical means, and +2 initiative (included).

Predator (feat, 2nd). Advantage on Stealth checks, and your Sneak Attack deals +1d6 (included).

Kit: The Veiled Ones. Silent Tail: Advantage to observe or tail someone unseen; a creature you watched for 10 minutes before a fight has Disadvantage on its attacks against you in the first round. Discreet Channels: Advantage on checks to gather, verify or pass on information quietly, or to explain why you're somewhere you shouldn't be.

Halfling. Move through the space of any larger creature. Advantage on farming, foraging and plant identification.

name: Ithrien Vael

weapons.name: Staff
weapons.notes: Staff: Versatile, Reach. Dagger: Finesse, Thrown 20ft.

weapons.name: dagger
weapons.notes: Staff: Versatile, Reach. Dagger: Finesse, Thrown 20ft.

spells.notes: Also in your spellbook: Sleep, Grease, Burning Hands, Comprehend Languages (1st).

personality: The Silver Tower sent you to Veradyna to catalogue the old magic of the frontier, and the Keepers were the only escort going north. You find the cold, the food and the company equally trying. You are very good, and you know it.
hook: Somewhere in this fort there is magic you can feel but not see.
abilitiesHtml:
Spellcasting. Intelligence. Spell save DC 14, 15 for Conjuration (School Focus). Slots: 5 cantrips, four 1st, two 2nd. Prepare 6 spells from your spellbook each morning. You cannot cast in armour or with a shield. See the spell page.

Arcane Recovery. Once a day, after 10 minutes of study, regain spent slots totalling up to 2 spell levels.

Scribe's Insight. Once a day, as part of casting a spell, swap one prepared spell for another of the same level from your spellbook.

School Focus: Conjuration. +1 to the save DC of your Conjuration spells (Grease, Web, Glitterdust).

Steady Focus (feat, 1st). Advantage on saves to keep a spell you are casting, or concentration, when damaged, shoved or forced to react. Once per encounter, turn one such failed save into a success.

Kit: Silver Tower Scholar. Elemental Precision: once per encounter, a spell you cast that deals elemental damage gives the target Disadvantage on its save. Aldorethi Theory: Advantage recalling Aldorethi magical theory or history.

High Elf. Trance (4 hours rests you). Keen Senses: Advantage on sight and hearing Perception. Arcane Sense: you feel significant magical auras within 60ft and their rough direction, no check. Extra cantrip (Read Magic). Weapon training: longsword, shortsword, longbow, rapier.
